do_not_reuse_as_train_labels: Acrobot lookahead development and confirmation tuples
Pendulum lookahead transfer holdout (17.1, 1.5, 0.8) and siblings
Default Pendulum (10, 1, 1) as a new holdout

experiments.title: PPO actor-critic + factory + architecture evolution
experiments.hypothesis: A configurable PyTorch actor-critic with a spec factory and mutation loop can train on CartPole-scale tasks.
experiments.reuse: Not LEVEL 2 transfer. Do not treat architecture search as learning-to-learn.

experiments.title: Multi-seed PPO CartPole/Acrobot and architecture evolution
experiments.hypothesis: Matched PPO recipes solve CartPole and improve Acrobot versus random.
experiments.reuse: Historical PPO evidence only. CartPole ceiling confounds evolution ranking.

experiments.title: LinUCB experiment selection versus random
experiments.hypothesis: A contextual bandit can select PPO experiments better than random on independent return.
experiments.reuse: Keep as a cheap scheduler. Not a path to learning-to-learn.

experiments.title: Sequential continual learning on CartPole variants
experiments.hypothesis: Naive/replay/EWC/multi-head beats specialists on CartPole variants.
experiments.reuse: Closed in V0.6.6. Do not retune the unsolved 8k PPO setup.

experiments.title: Encoder transfer versus scratch
experiments.hypothesis: A new head on a pretrained encoder beats scratch.
experiments.reuse: Do not claim representation learning until RMS is controlled.

experiments.title: RMS-only reuse
experiments.hypothesis: Normalization reuse is the useful transfer mechanism.
experiments.reuse: Statistics copy, not an improving learner.

experiments.title: Residual world-model H=3 planning on CartPole
experiments.hypothesis: A residual world model supports planning better than greedy or random.
experiments.reuse: The only reliably positive WM planning result, and only on CartPole.

experiments.title: Fine-tune world model on shifted CartPole
experiments.hypothesis: Fine-tuning lowers error and raises return.
experiments.reuse: Stop treating one-step MAE as the objective.

experiments.title: Past tasks reduce data needed on a new CartPole task D
experiments.hypothesis: ABC experience reduces data needed on D under MAE gating.
experiments.reuse: Closed. Not learning-to-learn.

experiments.title: Reptile versus matched multitask on Pendulum
experiments.hypothesis: First-order Reptile init adapts faster than matched-data multitask.
experiments.reuse: Not a general disproof of Reptile. Not learning-to-learn.

experiments.title: Planning-objective mismatch
experiments.hypothesis: Open-loop plan value is not first-action-plus-replan value.
experiments.reuse: Do not retune nested H=8 or score-correction from this class.

experiments.title: Q coverage or representation
experiments.hypothesis: Q coverage/representation explains closed 64-step Q/V failures.
experiments.reuse: Not the deployed H=16 receding rule.

experiments.title: H3 label collision — incomplete
experiments.hypothesis: Two later uses exist: occupancy-conditioned FiLM, and policy-induced distribution shift. A single H3 claim cannot be recovered without guessing.
experiments.reuse: Cite the specific later ID, not a generic H3.

experiments.title: Source MCC RMS adaptation
experiments.label: mcc_native_rms_not_established
experiments.reuse: Closed unused MCC split. Do not reuse as a train label.

experiments.title: Source MCC residual scale
experiments.label: mcc_residual_scale_harm_established
experiments.reuse: Closed. Do not reuse the same MCC split.

experiments.title: MCC multitask at 128 transitions
experiments.hypothesis: Within-family MCC multitask improves 128-transition adaptation versus scratch.
experiments.label: mcc_multitask_128_beats_scratch
experiments.reuse: One holdout. Not confirmation. Not learning-to-learn.

experiments.title: H10 confirmation on a new unused MCC holdout
experiments.hypothesis: The H10 recipe replicates on a new unused MCC holdout.
experiments.label: mcc_multitask_128_confirm_not_established
experiments.reuse: Closed unused MCC confirmation. Do not retune.

experiments.title: H10 recipe ranks shared H=16 candidates
experiments.hypothesis: The H10 recipe ranks shared H=16 candidates better than scratch.
experiments.label: mcc_planning_ranking_multitask_better
experiments.reuse: LEVEL 1 ranking. Not 200-step control. Closed unused MCC.

experiments.title: H12 ranking confirmation
experiments.hypothesis: The frozen H12 ranking recipe confirms on unused MCC (0.0039, 0.002, 0.075).
experiments.label: mcc_planning_ranking_confirm_multitask_better
experiments.reuse: Second ranking holdout. Recede is not the primary. Closed.

experiments.title: Fixed library versus redraw candidate reuse
experiments.hypothesis: A shared fixed candidate library helps multitask relative to redraw.
experiments.label: h14_fixed_library_helps_multitask_relative
experiments.reuse: Closed unused MCC (0.0023, 0.0019, 0.065). Not 200-step control. Not L2L.

experiments.title: H14 confirmation
experiments.hypothesis: The H14 fixed-versus-redraw DiD replicates on unused MCC (0.004, 0.0021, 0.05).
experiments.label: h15_fixed_library_helps_multitask_relative
experiments.reuse: Closed unused MCC confirmation. Do not retune.

experiments.title: Same-state library ranking
experiments.hypothesis: At later common states, L0 versus redraw changes selected-return DiD.
experiments.label: h16_same_state_library_effect_not_established
experiments.reuse: Closed unused MCC (0.0015, 0.0014, 0.055). Interval includes 0. Do not retune.

experiments.title: Occupancy and library factorial
experiments.hypothesis: Occupancy/library factors explain remaining same-state ranking.
experiments.label: blocked_unlocked_unauthorized
experiments.reuse: Do not execute. Do not select a target. Exclusion list is a blocklist only.

experiments.title: Parameter-free lookahead versus frozen H=16 on Pendulum
experiments.hypothesis: One-step successor backup of frozen H=16 value beats receding H=16 on 200-step return.
experiments.reuse: Algorithm copy on family-native models. Not cross-family learning.

experiments.title: Lookahead transfer on new Pendulum physics
experiments.hypothesis: The frozen lookahead package transfers to a new unused Pendulum holdout.
experiments.reuse: Closed lookahead_transfer_holdout_v1 tuples. Not L2L.

experiments.title: Lookahead versus H=16 on Acrobot
experiments.hypothesis: The same algorithm copy beats frozen H=16 on Acrobot development and confirmation.
experiments.reuse: Closed Acrobot lookahead holdouts. Do not shop a new unnamed confirmation.

experiments.title: Evolution-1 transferable proposal memory
experiments.hypothesis: Permitted memory of algorithm-improvement attempts helps discover planning configurations that transfer better than random, fixed, and equal-budget evolution.
experiments.reuse: Feasibility and fixture contracts only. Not a scientific result.

experiments.title: Evolution-1 autonomous toy loop
experiments.hypothesis: Permitted training feedback changes proposal weights and later choices.
experiments.reuse: Functional intervention, not transferable algorithm improvement.

experiments.title: Evolution-2 persistent versus reset synthetic contract
experiments.hypothesis: Retained proposal-policy state changes discovery on later synthetic tasks versus reset.
experiments.reuse: Authored hidden scores. Not LEVEL 2 evidence. Do not promote.

experiments.title: Pendulum to Acrobot catalogue-proposer screen v1
experiments.hypothesis: Persisting AdaptiveProposer state after default Pendulum improves Acrobot discovery versus reset, random, evolution, retrieval, and one frozen index.
experiments.reuse: Historical v1 lock. Do not collect. Holdout unnamed. See readiness review.

experiments.title: Pendulum/Acrobot catalogue-proposer screen v2
experiments.hypothesis: Retained proposer state across the first training family improves discovery on the second versus random, evolution, reset, and both H=16 anchors.
experiments.reuse: Superseding design. Do not collect. Do not name a holdout.

experiments.title: Trusted catalogue-to-planner adapter
experiments.hypothesis: The 12-variant catalogue can be bound to existing family scoring rules without changing historical lookahead modules.
experiments.reuse: Fake-model adapter. Not a scientific result. Do not collect.

experiments.title: Pendulum/Acrobot catalogue-proposer v2-pilot worksheet
experiments.hypothesis: The v2 persist-versus-five-controls question can be asked on six revealed rows and two development conditions without rewriting n, Bonferroni, or v2 hashes.
experiments.reuse: Reduced worksheet only. Do not collect. Do not rewrite v2. Holdout unnamed.

experiments.title: Independent unused-instance naming review
experiments.hypothesis: The unused-instance rule can now name Pendulum and Acrobot source and development physics for v2.
experiments.reuse: Naming blocked. Do not persist a physics tuple. Do not collect.
